notes.title: GIF Support Added
notes.content:
Animated GIF support has been added, this brilliant feature was suggested on the discussion forums.

To add an animated gif to your scene just navigate to Objects -> Animated Gif -> Select gif file from file browser.  Works exactly like images.

Thank you!
MultiVR.se Team

notes.title: Update: UnityChan, Anime Scene, Grab Push/Pull, Transparent Surface Drawing
notes.content:
[h1]Update[/h1]

A new MultiVR.se update has been published which contains...


[b]New Scene & Anime Character[/b]

A new Anime themed School Room Scene!  This scene contains an interactable anime style character named Unity Chan!  She can be moved and scaled like other items in the scene, and if you point at her and press Trigger she will change poses!


[b]Shards[/b]

Shards can now be configured by selecting a running windows application, this will set the position and size of the shard window to match the current position and size of the selected windows application.


[b]Moving Objects[/b]

When grabbing an object you can now swipe up or down on the trackpad(vive), or stick(Oculus Touch), to move a gripped object further or closer to yourself.


[b]Transparent Drawing Board[/b]

As requested by the community, we have added a transparent surface that you can draw on, its under the objects tab menu next to the whiteboard, blackboard and note. (This is really amazing to draw on, just note it is invisible so look for a black bar at the top that allows you to move it around).


-- Added some general improvements to scrolling for the Vive as well as various bug fixes.



Note:  File Browser Thumbnails - We are currently working on this feature and trying to optimize it as much as possible, its not currently available but if we can get it to run fast enough in VR we will be able to publish it.



Please let us know if you have any issues or suggestions as always!


[b]Thanks again![/b]

MultiVR.se Team

notes.title: Patch - AA Settings and more
notes.content:
Added configurable Anti Aliasing on the MultiVR.se application window(Expand the window if its too small or not visible).  Disabled/2X/4X/8X options are available.

Added rotation buttons to alter the rotation of the player to the MultiVR.se application window(again expand the window if you cant see the buttons).  This rotates the player left or right 10 degrees per click.

Fixed player position/rotation not being saved when changing scenes or exiting.

Moved Settings Tab to the main MultiVR.se application window for ease of access.

If you have any issues please let us know!

Thank you!
MultiVR.se Team

notes.title: Control Scheme Update
notes.content:
A new update has been released that is a step toward hopefully simplifying the MultiVR.se controls!

Here are the biggest changes
[list]
[*]Both Controllers are now identical (No more gray/blue laser differentiation).  This means that both controllers are capable of performing all actions.

[*]There are now only 4 total buttons in use.  Trigger, and Grip remain the same and have not changed.  Trackpad(Vive), and Stick(Oculus Touch) are now solely for teleportation.  Menu(Vive), and Y|B(Oculus Touch) are now for editing placed objects.  All other button functions have been moved to in-game context menus.

[*]SteamVR plugin has been updated to include the SteamVR teleporter mechanic and some other updates that will be useful in future versions.

[*]The Main Menu is now accessible by pointing and clicking Trigger on the Burger\Menu Icon that hovers above either controller.

[*]Main Menus and Keyboards are now hide-able.  The Vive Camera overlay and keyboard buttons now rest next to the main menu icon above the controller(When the main menu is visible).
[/list]

Quite a lot of changes have gone into this update, so please leave feedback in the discussion area if you are having any issues.


Thank you!
MultiVR.se Team

notes.title: New Scenes, Transparent Wallpapers, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]New Scenes![/h1]

A new patch as been released which is a step toward addressing some feedback about frame-rate of certain scenes.  We now have two categories of scenes, sitting and exploration.

[b]Sitting Scenes[/b] are better for seated experiences, generally have less overall scene detail and should be faster than exploration scenes.

[b]Exploration scenes[/b] are much larger, with far larger content, suited for exploration, but may require better hardware.

Sitting scenes will be designed more and more to be tuned towards ease of use for starting and stopping sessions.

[h1]Transparent Wallpapers[/h1]

A user requested feature, wallpapers now support alpha transparency in PNG's!  This means you can now place pictures that look like cut-outs in your scenes.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Color panel on lights not working.
A bunch of silent errors related to detecting Oculus or Vive devices and
steamvr tracked cameras.

notes.title: New Video Player and bug fixes!
notes.content:
A new update has gone live with the following updates...

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]Wallpaper/Image loading from external drives should now be fixed.
[*]Text File Viewer now resizes its height correctly based on the text.
[*]Delete Text File Viewer button should now property delete the text file window.
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]

A video player has been added!  The video player currently supports the following video formats.  (.mp4, .mov, .avi, .mkv, .divx, .mpeg, .xvid).  The video player will save its location in the scene and its autoplay configuration.

If you have any format support requests or issues please let us know!


[u]General Crashing or Black Screens[/u]
We have seen various reports of crashing or blank/black screens when starting MultiVR.se.  If you are experiencing crashing or black/blank screens please try the following.

[list]
[*]Update your Graphics Drivers if possible
[*]Delete your playerState.xml in C:\Users\name\AppData\LocalLow\VRider, Inc_\MultiVR_se, be advised this will clear all your scene configurations, take a backup if necessary!
[*]If these options don't work please post your crash log data in a post in the discussion forums so that we can help troubleshoot the issue.
[/list]

Thank you!
MultiVR.se Team
